summary: Not as a long entry. Across 1h, 4h and daily, K crossing up D, the same cross below 30, J crossing up 0 and J below 0 did the same as random entries on BTC, ETH and SOL. The result that holds up runs the other way: on 4h, shorting as J crossed down through 100 did 0.83% worse than random after 20 candles, because price kept rising.

verdicts.use: Buying the K-D cross (K crosses up D)
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, both on its own and when the cross happens below 30.

verdicts.use: Buying the dip (J below 0 or crossing up 0)
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily across the three pairs. The one exception is J below 0 on 1h in downtrends, covered in the notes.
Worse than random on 4h, and it holds without its strongest stretch. On 1h and daily it did the same as random.

verdicts.use: Shorting K crossing down D above 80
verdicts.text: Worse than random on daily, but only because of one stretch of signals. On 1h and 4h it did the same as random.

notes: On 1h, the default K crossing up D gave 14,049 entries in 1,185 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.03% behind random entries, inside the luck band. Requiring the cross below 30 cuts entries to about a fifth and still lands inside the band. On 4h the two settings were 0.14% and 0.16% behind random, also inside it.

Shorting as J crossed down through 100 on 4h did 0.83% worse than random after 20 candles. It shows at 10, 20 and 50 candles but not at 100. It holds without its strongest stretch, signals on Aug 14–16, 2021. SOL carries the most, 1.29% worse, and it shows there at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. ETH did the same as random.

The 4h J short splits by regime. In uptrends it did 0.78% worse than random, at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. In downtrends it did the same as random. J crossing down 100 marked strength that kept going while the pair was above its 200-day average, not tops.

J below 0 on 1h did the same as random when pooled, and the same in uptrends. In downtrends it beat random by 0.20% after 20 candles and held without its strongest stretch, signals on Jun 18–20, 2022. It showed at 20 and 50 candles, not at 10 or 100. J crossing up 0 in 1h downtrends also looked better than random, but the whole gap came from one entry on Jan 13, 2023.

Single stretches fake several other results. The daily short on K crossing down D above 80 looked 6.94% worse than random, but 5 signals between Aug 8, 2021 and Sep 9, 2021 carry it. On 4h, K crossing up D in uptrends looked worse only because of signals between Sep 16, 2025 and Nov 2, 2025. On BTC 1h, the same cross looked worse only because of signals between Apr 26, 2022 and May 13, 2022, during the Terra collapse.

For a long DCA bot, a KDJ cross as the start condition timed entries no better than a random candle on these pairs, so the DCA orders and take profit do the work. If you run a 1h long in downtrends, J below 0 is a filter to test beside a trend condition, with a take profit sized for 20 to 50 candles. For a short bot, J crossing down 100 on 4h opened against the move in uptrends, which is a reason to leave it out of a short start condition.
